traditions.KJV: A Song [ or ] Psalm of David .

2.english_reference: O God , my heart is fixed ;

traditions.LXX: Ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία μου , ὁ θεός , ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία μου ,
traditions.VUL: Parátum cor meum Deus , parátum cor meum :
traditions.KJV: O God , my heart is fixed ;

2.english_reference: I will sing and give praise ,

traditions.LXX: ᾄσομαι καὶ ψαλῶ
traditions.KJV: I will sing and give praise ,

traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ δόξῃ μου ·
traditions.KJV: even with my glory .

traditions.WLC: ע֭וּרָֽ ה הַ נֵּ֥בֶל וְ כִנּ֗וֹר
traditions.LXX: ἐγέρθητι , ψαλτήριον καὶ κιθάρα ·

traditions.LXX: ἐξεγερθήσομαι ὄρθρου .
traditions.KJV: I [ myself ] will awake early .

4.english_reference: I will praise thee , O LORD , among the people

traditions.LXX: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν λαοῖς , Κύριε ,
traditions.KJV: I will praise thee , O LORD , among the people :

4.english_reference: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations

traditions.LXX: καὶ ψαλῶ σοι ἐν ἔθνεσιν ·
traditions.KJV: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations .

5.english_reference: For thy mercy [ is ] great above the heavens

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי גָד֣וֹל מֵֽ עַל שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ ךָ

traditions.VUL: Quia magna est super cælos misericórdia tua :
traditions.KJV: For thy mercy [ is ] great above the heavens :

5.english_reference: and thy truth [ reacheth ] unto the clouds

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἕως τῶν νεφελῶν ἡ ἀλήθειά σου .
traditions.VUL: et usque ad nubes véritas tua .
traditions.KJV: and thy truth [ reacheth ] unto the clouds .

6.english_reference: Be thou exalted , O God , above the heavens

traditions.LXX: ὑψώθητι ἐπὶ τοὺς οὐρανούς , ὁ θεός ,
traditions.KJV: Be thou exalted , O God , above the heavens :

6.english_reference: and thy glory above all the earth

traditions.WLC: וְ עַ֖ל כָּל הָ אָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽ ךָ

traditions.VUL: et super omnem terram glória tua :
traditions.KJV: and thy glory above all the earth ;

7.english_reference: That thy beloved may be delivered

traditions.LXX: ὅπως ἂν ῥυσθῶσιν οἱ ἀγαπητοί σου ,
traditions.KJV: That thy beloved may be delivered :

7.english_reference: save [ with ] thy right hand , and answer me

traditions.LXX: σῶσον τῇ δεξιᾷ σου καὶ ἐπάκουσόν μου .
traditions.VUL: Salvum fac déxtera tua , et exáudi me :
traditions.KJV: save [ with ] thy right hand , and answer me .

8.english_reference: God hath spoken in his holiness

traditions.LXX: ὁ θεὸς ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Deus locútus est in sancto suo :
traditions.KJV: God hath spoken in his holiness ;

8.english_reference: I will rejoice , I will divide Shechem

traditions.LXX: Ὑψωθήσομαι καὶ διαμεριῶ Σίκιμα ,
traditions.KJV: I will rejoice , I will divide Shechem ,

8.english_reference: and mete out the valley of Succoth

traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν κοιλάδα τῶν σκηνωμάτων ἐκμετρήσω .
traditions.KJV: and mete out the valley of Succoth .

9.english_reference: Gilead [ is ] mine ; Manasseh [ is ] mine

traditions.WLC: לִ֤ י גִלְעָ֨ד לִ֤ י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה

traditions.KJV: Gilead [ is ] mine ; Manasseh [ is ] mine ;

9.english_reference: Ephraim also [ is ] the strength of mine head

traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἐφράιμ ἀντίλημψις τῆς κεφαλῆς μου ·

traditions.LXX: Ἰούδας βασιλεύς μου ,

traditions.LXX: Μωὰβ λέβης τῆς ἐλπίδος μου ·

10.english_reference: over Edom will I cast out my shoe

traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ τὴν Ἰδουμαίαν ἐκτενῶ τὸ ὑπόδημά μου ,

traditions.LXX: ἐμοὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ὑπετάγησαν .
traditions.KJV: over Philistia will I triumph .

11.english_reference: Who will bring me into the strong city ?

traditions.LXX: τίς ἀπάξει με εἰς πόλιν περιοχῆς ?
traditions.VUL: Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam ?
traditions.KJV: Who will bring me into the strong city ?

traditions.LXX: τίς ὁδηγήσει με ἕως τῆς Ἰδουμαίας ?
traditions.VUL: quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam ?
traditions.KJV: who will lead me into Edom ?

traditions.LXX: οὐχὶ σύ , ὁ θεός , ὁ ἀπωσάμενος ἡμᾶς ?
traditions.VUL: Nonne tu Deus , qui repulísti nos ?
traditions.KJV: [ Wilt ] not [ thou ] , O God , [ who ] hast cast us off ?

traditions.WLC: נוּ וְֽ לֹא תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּ צִבְאֹתֵֽי נוּ

traditions.KJV: and wilt not thou , O God , go forth with our hosts ?

traditions.LXX: δὸς ἡμῖν βοήθειαν ἐκ θλίψεως ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ματαία σωτηρία ἀνθρώπου .
traditions.KJV: for vain [ is ] the help of man .

14.english_reference: Through God we shall do valiantly :

traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ θεῷ ποιήσομεν δύναμιν ,
traditions.KJV: Through God we shall do valiantly :

traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξουδενώσει τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ἡμῶν .
